criteria.criterion: steward::run invokes an AgentDriver with STEWARD_PROMPT as the system prompt and records the invocation (role, usage, cost) like other roles; note_finished still runs it in the background without blocking.
criteria.evidence: From reading steward.rs: consult() builds the spec with steward_system_prompt(&role.prompt) (role.prompt is STEWARD_PROMPT) and Role::Steward, calls athena.invoke_and_record, and stashes the Invocation record, which is committed with the items. store.rs loads it into Records.steward_runs. note_finished clones an Arc driver into spawn_background. The test checks role, tokens, cost and the stored prompt (tests/steward.rs:225-283).

criteria.criterion: The gh policy in policy.rs is allow-list based for flags: any word starting with -f/-F (attached forms like -ftitle=x, -Fx=@f), --field, --raw-field, -X/--method other than GET, --input, and mutating git/gh commands are denied; unit tests cover these denied forms and the allowed reads (gh run list/view, gh pr list/view, gh api GET).
criteria.evidence: check_gh denies any arg starting with -f or -F, plus --field, --raw-field and --input, before anything else runs. It then applies per-command action and flag allow-lists, and allows a method only when it is GET (all spellings). Tests the_steward_cannot_write_to_github_in_any_flag_form and the_steward_may_read_github both passed.

criteria.criterion: Agent output is structured work items (kind, key, title, rung, source and evidence refs, request text); Athena validates it and routes every item through decide(): rungs at or below the limit queue a Request, higher rungs queue only a proposal with evidence.
criteria.evidence: From reading the code: validate_items/validate_item check the title, key alphabet, references (a cited job must exist), evidence present, and a request when the rung is within the limit. run() sends every candidate through decide(), and may_change picks Applied (a queued Request) or Proposed. The scripted test asserts one request for the lower rung and a proposal only for brief-requirements.

criteria.criterion: Each unreadable source (including GitHub unavailable) becomes a blind-spot item whose key uses only the stable source name, not error text; items whose key already exists in records are not queued twice.
criteria.evidence: blind_spot_key(source) = "blind-spot:{source}". validate_item rebuilds the key of a model-reported blind spot from a known source name (github included), and check_key rejects keys the model writes itself with that prefix. run() skips keys already in records.work_items. The tests github_being_unavailable_is_one_blind_spot_whatever_the_error_says and a_second_run_with_the_same_keys_queues_nothing_again passed.

criteria.criterion: The old repeated_failures counting is removed or passed to the agent as input; docs/design/roles-and-ladder.md and CHANGELOG.md say the steward now calls a model and state the git-history and model/budget limits.
criteria.evidence: repeated_failures() is now only passed to brief() under the heading 'Counted by Athena (an input, not a finding)'. roles-and-ladder.md has a Limits section covering git history (GIT-LOG.txt of 200 commits plus a one-commit snapshot) and model/budget (borrows the verifier's). CHANGELOG states both.

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test`: crates/athena-cli/tests/steward.rs with the fake driver shows (a) scripted output with a real gap commits the work item and a queued request, (b) empty output makes no commit, (c) a second run with the same keys queues nothing again, (d) a nested run makes no real model call, and (e) the fake agent's recorded reads cover the named sources (jobs, events, introspections, class registry, decisions, git log).
criteria.evidence: All 10 tests passed (43.7s), among them scripted_output_with_a_real_gap_commits_the_work_items_and_a_queued_request, empty_output_makes_no_commit_and_its_invocation_waits_for_the_next_one, a_second_run_with_the_same_keys_queues_nothing_again, a_nested_run_makes_no_model_call, and the_fake_steward_reads_every_named_source_in_a_workspace_without_private_files. The last asserts that commands_run lists jobs, events, introspections, class-registry, decisions, git-log and code. Athena's full cargo test run also passed (584 tests).

findings.summary: A file outside the expected deliverables was changed: docs/design/requirements-map.md
findings.evidence: Row A9-1's Partial note is reworded to say the steward now calls a model. The row stays Partial and the text is accurate, but the file is not on the deliverables list.

findings.summary: The docs and the policy allow `gh workflow list|view`, but the steward's actual grant does not include `workflow`
findings.evidence: The grant's gh commands are ["run","pr","api"], while roles-and-ladder.md and the policy module doc list gh workflow list|view as allowed. The brief also mentions only run/pr/api. The agent's tools are safe, but the docs overstate what it can run.

findings.summary: When RecordSet fails to load, `decisions` is not marked unreadable
findings.evidence: On a load error only jobs, events, introspections and class-registry are pushed to unreadable. The decisions source (records/decision-states, default-expectations) is also part of records/.

summary: The change passes: all seven acceptance criteria are met and nothing found is blocker or major. The steward is now a model-backed, read-only agent. It runs with the stored STEWARD_PROMPT through the shared driver, its invocation is recorded as a steward record, and every validated item goes through decide(). The gh policy denies field flags in every form, -f/-F and attached spellings like -ftitle=x included, and allows a method only when it is GET; the tests cover these forms. Blind-spot keys use only the stable source name. I ran the 10 steward integration tests and the 2 steward policy tests (all passed), plus `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --check` (both clean). Three small issues: docs/design/requirements-map.md changed although it is not on the deliverables list (an accurate rewording; the row stays Partial). The docs list `gh workflow` as allowed, but the steward's grant leaves it out. When records fail to load, the `decisions` source is not marked as a blind spot. All runs were in the snapshot. Like the change's own docs say, the steward has not been run against the real driver.
